scenario: [LSTR.3.2] Ordering is by codepoint, not locale or case-folded alphabetical order. "a" is U+0061 and "Z" is U+005A, so "a" > "Z"; "Y" (U+0059) is not. Against `i.label > "Z"` only "a" fires. A locale-aware or case-insensitive comparison puts "a" before "Z" and logs nothing.
rules_ds:
schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    label: String mutable

rule hit:
    Item i where i.label > "Z"
->
    log info "{i.label}"
